disqualifier.note: Independent CLI axes; list||print selects display vs resume, json is output format, force independently skips the live-session guard. Combined list+print is handled as display, not a masked union.
Independent axes; dryRun skips filesystem writes while force independently allows replacing an existing packet. Combined dryRun+force is a dry-run of a replacement, not a masked union.
Independent CLI axes; archive preserves residue while deleteBranch separately requests git-branch deletion. All four combinations are legal.
